plan.estimand: Main effect of 3-level factor in balanced 3-by-2 factorial ANOVA
plan.hypothesis: Null: no main effect of 3-level factor; Alternative: nonzero main effect (two-sided at α=0.05)
assumptions: Balanced design: equal sample size per cell
All 6 cells (3×2) are independent
Full interaction model includes main effects and A×B interaction
Homogeneity of variance across all cells
Normality of residuals within cells
F-test for main effect of 3-level factor A with 2 numerator df
Partial eta-squared = 0.06 reflects the effect size of factor A main effect
Power analysis uses noncentral F-distribution
missing_information: None identified; all essential design parameters provided
scientific_notes: Partial eta-squared measures the proportion of variance explained by the 3-level factor main effect, adjusted for all other effects in the full factorial model
Denominator df = (n_per_cell × 6) - 6 will depend on the solved n_per_cell
The two-sided test is standard for an omnibus main effect ANOVA; the effect size is interpreted in magnitude without direction
This is an inversion problem: find minimum n_per_cell such that achieved power ≥ 0.80
